C0699.title: Shenzhen Nanshan Court Heard a 'Zero-Cost' No-Inventory Online Store Trademark Infringement Case
C0699.summary: In 2025, the Shenzhen Nanshan District People's Court disclosed a trademark infringement case involving a 'zero-cost' no-inventory online store. Wu bought low-cost one-click listing software, copied product titles, links and prices from other platforms in bulk, uploaded them to a personal store, and after receiving orders bought matching products from other platforms for delivery. Company A sued after finding two home textile products in Wu's store using its registered trademarks in link names and display images. The court held that Wu used similar marks prominently without permission, constituting trademark infringement, and ordered 5,000 yuan in compensation for economic losses and reasonable enforcement costs. The judgment has taken effect.
